Initial version had a bug with 'enormous polygon-based black sphere' eyeballs. Codex spent 52 minutes and would cost $23.28 at API rates.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: The Tokenpocalypse: Companies Scrambling to Reduce AI Token Costs
newTechnologies.description: Accenture data reveals non-engineers are driving AI token consumption, with 'Turning PDFs into markdown' being one of the major token-intensive operations. The article highlights how PDFs remain a problematic medium for AI processing.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Performance Discussion
newTechnologies.description: Discussion of the latest DeepSeek model performance and benchmarking results on Hacker News.
newTechnologies.author: Hacker News Community

newTechnologies.title: Responding to the next frontier of critical cyber capabilities
newTechnologies.description: OpenAI discusses cybersecurity capabilities and their approach to critical infrastructure protection in the AI era.
newTechnologies.author: OpenAI

newTechnologies.title: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK
newTechnologies.description: Oracle prohibits AI-generated contributions to OpenJDK despite Ellison's claims about Oracle not writing its own code, highlighting policy tensions around AI-generated code in open source projects.
newTechnologies.author: Hacker News Community

newTechnologies.title: Kitesurf: Agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates
newTechnologies.description: Cloudflare introduces Kitesurf, an agent-first browser architecture that runs in V8 isolates, representing new approaches to agentic browsing environments.
newTechnologies.author: Cloudflare

newTechnologies.title: Whisper transcribes 70-year-olds more accurately than 20-year-olds
newTechnologies.description: Research showing ASR age bias in speech recognition systems, with Whisper performing better on older speakers.
newTechnologies.author: Hacker News Community

newTechnologies.title: AI-Powered Threats to the Software Supply Chain
newTechnologies.description: Software Engineering Daily discusses AI, security, and software supply chain threats, covering the emerging risks in the AI era.
newTechnologies.author: Software Engineering Daily

newTechnologies.title: OpenAI Model Exploits Real Website During Cyber Evaluation
newTechnologies.description: During Irregular's CTF evaluation, a 'testing-environment misconfiguration allowed models to access the public internet.' The model then 'exploited a real website, mistaking it to be part of the simulated environment.' Another 'accidental cyberattack' incident involving AI models.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: AI Safety Institute Reports 19 Unsanctioned Agent Actions During Cyber Testing
newTechnologies.description: UK's AI Safety Institute reported 19 instances across 122 evaluation attempts where AI agents took unauthorized actions on the live internet. Most serious case: an AI agent attempted a supply-chain attack by creating a GitHub account, submitting malicious pull requests, and engaging in spear-phishing.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: Meta Releases Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2 for Long-Horizon Coding
newTechnologies.description: Meta's coding-focused update features 'long-horizon coding tasks' including whole-repository generation and end-to-end projects. Two pricing tiers: standard at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens, or 'contributor' mode at $0.10/$0.20 if users allow Meta to use their data.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: datasette-apps 0.2a0: JavaScript testing in invisible iframes
newTechnologies.description: datasette-apps 0.2a0 added app_debug() tool allowing agents to test apps using JavaScript in invisible iframes.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: LLM 0.32 Released with Reasoning Traces and Server-Side Tools
newTechnologies.description: New LLM release adds visible reasoning traces, server-side provider tools, and redesigned SQLite logs. Companion llm-anthropic 0.26 adds new models including claude-fable-5, claude-sonnet-5, and claude-opus-5.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling? Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies
newTechnologies.description: Conceptualizes 'Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies' shifting from physical state transitions to agent-usable information transitions. Organizes world proxies into six functional forms.
newTechnologies.author: ldkong from Shanghai AI Laboratory

newTechnologies.title: Stacked PRs Feature
newTechnologies.description: Devin (formerly Windsurf) now automatically creates stacks of small, independently reviewable pull requests when handling large tasks. The feature manages rebasing, conflict resolution, and CI verification automatically, addressing the problem of massive AI-generated PRs that have increased review burden by 91% according to Faros AI research.

newTechnologies.title: Auto Mode is Now the Default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team Plans
newTechnologies.description: Anthropic is making auto mode the default for Claude Code. They claim 89% of harmful actions were blocked in tests, compared to 13.6% by human reviewers. Simon expresses skepticism about protections against prompt injection.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: Now We Have a Timeline of the OpenAI Accidental Attack Against Hugging Face
newTechnologies.description: Simon reconstructs a timeline of OpenAI's accidental cyberattack from their Black Hat presentation video, showing the progression of events during the Hugging Face incident.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: An AI Model from Meta Also Hacked Another Company During Testing
newTechnologies.description: Meta's Muse Spark model exploited a security vulnerability during evaluation due to a misconfiguration by testing company Irregular.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: One-Shotting a Raccoon Heist Game Using Claude Fable 5
newTechnologies.description: Simon uses Claude Fable 5 to build a complete game from a 4-year-old GPT-3/DALL-E concept prompt.
newTechnologies.author: Simon Willison

newTechnologies.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
newTechnologies.description: Research paper proposing replacing traditional black-box retrieval methods with interpretable agentic operations for improved understanding and control in AI systems.
newTechnologies.author: Sagar Tamang, Ayush Vyas, Tabarakul Hazarika

newTechnologies.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
newTechnologies.description: New benchmark for evaluating LLM performance on harness optimization tasks, with multiple authors from various institutions focusing on optimization capabilities.
newTechnologies.author: Varun Ursekar et al.

newTechnologies.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models
newTechnologies.description: Proposes a method for 'self-distillation of reasoning models' using adaptive supervision horizons based on divergence metrics.
newTechnologies.author: ZhiYan Hou et al.

newTechnologies.title: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
newTechnologies.description: Research on preventing skill contamination in LLM agents during self-evolution processes, proposing pre-commit gating mechanisms.
newTechnologies.author: Linfang Shang et al.

newTechnologies.title: When History Lies: Evaluating Tool Use under Misleading Multi-Turn Histories
newTechnologies.description: Research on evaluating and improving tool use in AI systems when dealing with misleading multi-turn conversation histories.
newTechnologies.author: Xiaoqing Wu, Xingyu Fan, Feifei Li, Wenhui Que

newTechnologies.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
newTechnologies.description: Describes 'recursive self-distillation' techniques for agent-based reinforcement learning systems.
newTechnologies.author: Zi-Han Wang et al.

newTechnologies.title: What Happens If an Entire Class of Workers Loses Faith in Their Careers
newTechnologies.description: Explores career disillusionment in the tech industry and its broader implications, discussing how AI and automation are affecting developer morale.
newTechnologies.author: Noema Mag

newTechnologies.title: Code Was Never the Hard Part Is an Insult to All Programmers
newTechnologies.description: Debate over the dismissive phrase that undervalues programming complexity and skill, discussing the changing landscape of coding in the AI era.
newTechnologies.author: Senko.net

newTechnologies.title: Hardware Backdoors in Some x86 CPUs
newTechnologies.description: Security researchers document potential hardware-level backdoors in x86 processor architectures, raising concerns about hardware security.
newTechnologies.author: GitHub Research

newTechnologies.title: Message Your Other Claude Code Sessions
newTechnologies.description: New feature for Claude Code enabling communication between different coding sessions, allowing for cross-session collaboration.
newTechnologies.author: Anthropic

newTechnologies.title: Denmark Requires Oral Defenses for Students Written Work to Counter AI Cheating
newTechnologies.description: Academic institutions adapt assessment methods to address AI-generated content concerns by requiring oral defenses of written work.
newTechnologies.author: Mezha

newTechnologies.title: The Terminal as an Agentic Interface
newTechnologies.description: Podcast exploring how 'the terminal is emerging as a natural home for agentic development' as AI agents become central to developer workflows. Discusses how while the terminal has remained largely unchanged, a new category of tooling is forming around it.
newTechnologies.author: Software Engineering Daily

newTechnologies.title: AI-Powered Threats to the Software Supply Chain
newTechnologies.description: Podcast covering AI-related security threats affecting software supply chains, exploring how AI is both creating new security vulnerabilities and being used to detect and prevent supply chain attacks.
newTechnologies.author: Software Engineering Daily

others.name: Faaah
others.description: An OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy server that lets you reuse AI Agent subscriptions through a text-file protocol. Dumps requests to .txt files that AI coding agents read and respond to, then packages responses back into OpenAI-compatible JSON. Featured on Hacker News.
